task: INT-1 independent line-by-line verification of the published boards

checks.check: Root board: every published no-vig probability re-derived from its quoted odds
checks.detail: 10 priced rows; per-source probabilities, overrounds, consensus means and min/max ranges all reproduce exactly.

checks.check: Live board: every market probability re-derived from its quoted odds
checks.detail: 16 market rows and 107 originated-estimate rows; all per-source de-vigs and the Elo-style estimate arithmetic reproduce. The published consensus averages unrounded per-source probabilities while per-source values are stored rounded to 4 dp, so a recomputation from the rounded values can differ by 0.01 percentage point; the displayed percentage is unaffected.

checks.check: Live board: pick side, pick team and edge re-derived
checks.detail: Every published pick is the higher published probability with an edge above 0.005, and every published edge equals the absolute probability gap.

checks.check: Originated-estimate ratings are real rows of Valve's official standings
checks.detail: 214 team ratings checked against 349 distinct team names in standings_global_2026_10_05.md; every used (standing, points) pair is a row of that file. 37 of them are team names Valve lists on more than one roster line, so more than one official row exists for that name.

checks.check: Blank rows for a missing rating are flagged, never estimated
checks.detail: 351 rows published with no probability. Of those, 306 are League of Legends rows, which carry no_official_rating_source_for_lol because Valve publishes CS2 regional standings only, and every CS2 row whose team is absent from the official standings carries no_valve_vrs_rating:<team>. No blank row is estimated. 1 blank CS2 row(s) do not name every team whose rating is missing, so the reason is under-reported on those rows even though the row itself stays blank.

checks.check: Every per-row HotSpawn link is an official URL HotSawn publishes
checks.detail: The inherited collectors used https://www.hotspawn.com/matches/<fixture id> on every row; OBS-02 shows that route resolves to the general matches index. Repaired to published permalinks where HotSawn publishes one and to the official lobby page otherwise: 25 published permalinks + 64 lobby fallbacks on the root board, 26 + 448 on the live board, and 26 + 1184 on the expanded market board. No row links a constructed path.

checks.check: Committed lobby snapshot cross-checked against an independent re-read
checks.detail: The committed snapshot (90 fixtures, tiers s4/b26/c60) and the independent re-read (89 fixtures, tiers s4/b25/c60) are different observations 32 minutes apart: the lobby changed between them. The lobby's own "68 matches this week" counter is still not reproduced by any rule applied to either observation and stays published as unexplained rather than guessed.
